card.name: Punctuation after "below" cross-references
card.fires_on: The comma, closing parenthesis or period right after the word "below" when it points the reader to a later section, as in "(described below)," or "(see ... sections, below)".

modes.label: Punctuation after below
modes.description: A comma, parenthesis or period that closes a "described below" or "see below" cross-reference.
